run_bitext_processor_module: run the BitextProcessorModule to process pairs of source and target bitext files using a configured processor callback
create_bitext_processor_callback: create a subclass of BitextProcessorCallback to process batches of lines from two input files and write to output files
configure_bitext_processor_config: configure a BitextProcessorConfig dataclass with processor target, output directory, shards list, and resource requirements
implement_process_lines: implement the process_lines abstract method in a BitextProcessorCallback subclass to handle DatasetLine generator input
get_final_result: call the final_result method on a BitextProcessorCallback to retrieve the output file names after processing
